description:
Crawl https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider to identify pages that use the 'X-Robots-Tag' HTTP header (e.g., for noindex or nofollow directives). 

STEPS:
1. Start a crawl of 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
2. Wait for the crawl to complete.
3. Navigate to the 'Directives' tab to view robots instructions.
4. Identify pages that have an 'X-Robots-Tag' header value (look for the 'X-Robots-Tag' column).
5. Export the Directives data for these pages to a CSV file named 'x_robots_header_report.csv' in the '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' directory.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- A CSV file named 'x_robots_header_report.csv' exists in the exports folder.
- The CSV contains an 'X-Robots-Tag' column with values (e.g., 'noindex', 'nofollow').
- The export includes the specific test pages from crawler-test.com (e.g., /headers/x_robots_tag_noindex).
